text: Bez vepřového masa, šunky, slaniny a uzenin
ipa: bˈez vˈepr̝ovˌeːho mˈasa, ʃˈuŋki, slˈaɲini a ˈuzeɲin
literal: names ham, bacon and sausage individually, matching the corpus's Spanish/French rows: in Czech cooking cured pork reads as seasoning rather than meat, so 'no meat' alone does not reach it
sádlo (pork lard) -- traditional in Czech cooking itself (chlebíček se sádlem), so this is not a marginal question here
present tense, formal vy -- avoids the gendered past-tense form of doporučit
